name: Tofu and Mushroom Masala Breakfast Quesadilla
steps: Pat tofu dry. Heat oil in a skillet and cook mushrooms until their moisture evaporates.
Add onion, capsicum, cumin and paprika; cook 2 minutes.
Add tofu and cook 4 minutes until lightly golden. Finish with lime and coriander.
Divide filling over half of each tortilla; spoon on salsa and fold closed.
Toast in a dry skillet 2 minutes per side until crisp and hot. Cut into wedges.
note: Vegan if tortillas and salsa contain no dairy or honey. Check labels.
